rics.meaning: Private Consumer Spending, constant prices — household final consumption expenditure component of GDP. Same conceptual measure as aIDCPCED/CA in different framing.
rics.how_to_use: Use aIDCPCEYD/A for YoY pace; this level series for analytical baseline. Indonesia's private consumption share of GDP (~55%) is high vs East Asian peers (40-50%) — reflects services-economy structure.
